title: TatBLiMP: A Benchmark of Linguistic Minimal Pairs for Tatar
abstract: arXiv:2609.20832v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce TatBLiMP, the first benchmark of linguistic minimal pairs for Tatar (tt, ISO 639-3 tat), a Qypchaq Turkic language written in Cyrillic. To our knowledge it is the first grammaticality evaluation for Tatar language models of any kind, since even the 101-language MultiBLiMP does not include Tatar. TatBLiMP covers 16 morphosyntactic phenomena in 1248 sentence pairs. Each pair differs by a single morpheme, one grammatical and one ungrammatical. A model passes a pair when it assigns higher probability to the grammatical member. Scoring compares probabilities the model already assigns, so the benchmark needs no text generation and no parser, and it runs on base models and on mid-training checkpoints. TatBLiMP adapts the phenomenon inventory and single-morpheme breaking operations of TurBLiMP to Tatar and adds one phenomenon specific to Tatar, bare-noun number after numerals and quantifiers. translated_title: TatBLiMP：面向塔塔尔语的语言学最小对测试基准
translated_abstract: 我们提出了TatBLiMP，这是首个针对塔塔尔语（tt，ISO 639-3 tat）的语言学最小对测试基准。塔塔尔语是一种使用西里尔字母书写的钦察突厥语。据我们所知，这是首次对任何类型的塔塔尔语语言模型进行语法性评估，因为即使是涵盖101种语言的MultiBLiMP也不包含塔塔尔语。TatBLiMP涵盖16种形态句法现象，共包含1248个句子对。每一对句子仅相差一个语素，其中一个是合语法的，另一个是不合语法的。当模型给合语法的句子分配更高的概率时，即视为通过该对测试。评分仅比较模型已经分配的概率，因此该基准无需文本生成，也无需句法分析器，并且可以在基础模型和中期训练检查点上运行。TatBLiMP将TurBLiMP的现象清单和单语素破坏操作适配到塔塔尔语，并增加了一个塔塔尔语特有的现象：数词和量词之后光杆名词的数。每一对中合语法的句子是……
tldr: TatBLiMP是首个针对塔塔尔语的语言学最小对基准，通过1248个仅相差一个语素的句子对覆盖16种形态句法现象，无需文本生成或句法分析器即可评估语言模型的语法能力。
en_tdlr: TatBLiMP is the first benchmark of linguistic minimal pairs for Tatar, covering 16 morphosyntactic phenomena in 1248 single-morpheme sentence pairs, enabling grammaticality evaluation of language models without text generation or parsers.
